newsitem.title: UK: BNFL says bidding for 50 mln stg fuel storage deal.
newsitem.headline: BNFL says bidding for 50 mln stg fuel storage deal.

text.p: British Nuclear Fuels Plc said on Monday it was bidding for a contract worth more than 50 million stg to store used fuel from the Chernobyl reactors in the Ukraine.
A BNFL statement said a group of Ukrainian ministers and the Ukrainian ambassador to the UK were touring BNFL sites this week.

"They will meet senior BNFL representatives to learn about technical solutions and expertise BNFL can offer to help with decommissioning and waste management at the Chernobyl site," the UK company said.

The interim storage solution would involve construction of a dry spent fuel storage system in the Ukraine. BNFL would supply design and technical expertise, with construction and operation being provided by the local people of the Ukraine.
